votes.motion: Nominate Dave Matthews to serve as Chair of the BOS.
votes.quote: mr. alonzo motioned to nominate dave matthews to serve as the chair of the bos. ms. bertram seconded. on vote, motion carried, 5 in favor, 0 opposed.

votes.motion: Nominate Tom Alonzo to serve as Vice Chair of the BOS.
votes.quote: mr. matthews motioned to nominate tom alonzo as vice chair of the bos. mr. debettencourt seconded. on vote, motion carried, 5 in favor, 0 opposed.

votes.motion: Nominate Ernie Sund to serve as Clerk of the BOS.
votes.quote: ms. bertram motioned to nominate ernie sund as clerk of the bos. mr. debettencourt seconded. on vote, motion carried, 5 in favor, 0 opposed.

votes.motion: Accept the Remote Participation Policy with the adjustments suggested by Mr. Alonzo and verification with Town Counsel, with the adjustment made by Mr. Sund.
votes.quote: mr. alonzo seconded. on vote, motion carried, 3 in favor, 2 opposed (sund & debettencourt)

votes.motion: Accept the form of vote read into the record to authorize the advanced refunding of the 2003 bond issue, so bids can be solicited.
votes.quote: ms. speidel said yes it would be for 10 years. on vote, motion carried, 5 in favor, 0 opposed.
being no further business, mr. debettencourt motioned to adjourn the meeting. ms. bertram seconded. on vote, motion carried, 5 in favor, 0 opposed.
